title.zh: OpenAI回应安全研究人员离职：因敏感信息违规，并非针对提出安全担忧行为
title.en: OpenAI回应安全研究人员离职：因敏感信息违规，并非针对提出安全担忧行为

current_state.zh: OpenAI said it terminated three former employees — Jasmine, Mikita and Tomek — for violating sensitive-information handling policies and serious breaches of trust beyond what their public letter disclosed, denying the move was retaliation for raising safety concerns, while stating it is finalizing contracts with third-party safety evaluators to be announced in the coming weeks.
